title: cloudflareSafety
responsibility: Rejects lower Worker targets whose routes overlap production or contain ambiguous wildcard hosts.

inputs.name: cloudflareSafety.config
inputs.description: Validated environment mapping whose target identities and promotion boundaries must remain unchanged.

inputs.name: cloudflareSafety.targets
inputs.description: Explicit environment targets to compare against inherited and production Worker routes.

outputs.name: cloudflareSafety
outputs.description: Returns without a value only for distinct lower routes; throws for unsafe mappings.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects unsafe source, target or promotion state; no successful deployment receipt is recorded.
